description: Cursor-based stock feed across stores (POST /b2b/v1/stocks/query). Returns {stocks: [{product_id, quantity, shelf_type, store_id}], cursor}; iterate until a page has fewer items than limit for a full snapshot. Known shelf_type values (open-ended): store, markdown, incoming, out, trash, lost, found, office, parcel, parcel_returned, collection, cargo, repacking, review, kitchen_on_demand, kitchen_components, kitchen_trash, kitchen_lost, kitchen_found. Sellable stock normally lives on shelf_type "store".

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response of this tool. Omit it for the first page; the feed is exhausted when a page comes back with fewer items than `limit`.

limit.description: Page size (default 100 — the official client's value; the server-side maximum is undocumented).

name: query_stocks
title: Query stock levels
